name: SplitPolyByLine
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,xp,yp,xq,yq,LET(originShapeArr, vertices, Intersects, {ref}PolyAndLineIntersection(originShapeArr, xp, yp, xq, yq), numOfIntersections, ROWS(Intersects), output, IF(numOfIntersections = 2, {ref}SplitPolyIntoTwoPolys(originShapeArr, xp, yp, xq, yq), {ref}SplitPolysIteration(originShapeArr, Intersects)), output))
comment: Splits a closed polygon by a line segment. vertices is an n×2 array of (x, y) rows in order; the last vertex connects to the first. The segment is (xp, yp) to (xq, yq). Two intersections return two polygons. Four or more are paired in sorted order by SplitPolysIteration. Each result row is a strict ARRAYTOTEXT of (x, y) rows. No intersection returns #N/A. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
